interface.shortDescription: Your Codex just hired Cursor. Tokenmaxxing, unlocked.
interface.longDescription: Tokenmaxxing for the Astra × Grok era. When your GPT-6 Astra budget in Codex runs low and your Grok 4.6 allowance in Cursor still has room, put that capacity to work. Cursourcing keeps your chosen Codex model in charge and encourages useful delegation to Cursor for investigation, implementation, debugging, and validation. Supports asynchronous work, concurrent tasks, follow-ups, and session recovery. Each service uses its own account and allowance.
defaultPrompt: Use $cursourcing to plan this task, delegate useful work to Cursor as it develops, and review the results.
